title: Conditions Without si in Market Forecasts
goal: Compress market scenarios and policy forecasts using de + infinitive and gerund conditions.

items: I can express possible and negative market conditions without *si* using *de* + infinitive and *de no* + infinitive.
I can compress an unfulfilled past economic condition with *de* + *haber* + past participle.
I can discuss slowdowns and monetary policy using terms such as *la recesión*, *el estancamiento* and *el préstamo*.
